arguments.message: Hi! If the project was deleted this morning, you should still be able to recover it. An admin can go to Settings → Data → Deleted items and restore the project from there – it will come back with all its records, configuration and automation rules intact. You’ll have 30 days from the deletion date to do this. If it’s been more than 30 days, unfortunately it can’t be recovered. Let us know if you need help locating the Deleted items section!
